name: status-row
notes: The status row only exists when should_render_status_row() is true, which needs a status_message while idle. /status arms the TRANSCRIPT (it pushes a system annotation, so this scenario still pins the system-annotation transcript style and the 'Session status' text), but its copy in the status ROW is an EVENT with a three-second TTL (iter-1871), so it is gone by the time the frame is captured — the row cannot be armed by /status any more. Alt+Y enters copy mode, whose hint is a MODE and therefore persistent (set_status_message_persistent), so the status row IS in the captured frame and the row's rendering stays pinned. NOTE: deliberately does NOT assert any_modal_open — on a host with audio, voice_mode_notice is visible from frame 0, so any_modal_open is true for the whole run and the assertion would be host-dependent rather than surface-dependent.
